short: A determinant bound for log-prime-weighted gains

lean.name: Formalism.B.DetGain
lean.plain: A determinant bound for log-prime-weighted gains
lean.note: Let $\Delta$ be a nonzero integer determinant. If each local gain $g_p$ is at most the exponent of $p$ in $|\Delta|$, then $\sum_p g_p\log p\le\log|\Delta|$, with the sum over the specified primes. This product-formula estimate is outside the final dependency cone.
